svg.desc: algebraCOEF: 2 echoes from scale 0.62 to 1.25; normal coefficient 0.65, tangent coefficient 1.35; 2 affine repetitions. Seeded starting-parameter randomization varies the native source before algebra; both color orders share the same sampled settings.
